description: An application that starts successfully and displays Hello, World!
primary_goal: Display Hello, World! when the application starts successfully.
entity_basis: The source requires startup and a displayed greeting, with no business data entities.

primary_user_story.bytes: A user starts the application successfully and sees Hello, World!

then.bytes: the application starts successfully and displays Hello, World!

text.bytes: When started, the application MUST display Hello, World!

extractions.source:
# Hello World Application

## Requirements

- The application must start successfully.
- When started, the application must display `Hello, World!`.
extractions.claim: The application must start successfully and display Hello, World! when started.
